turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on always, usually, sometimes and never?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Great topic. Always, usually, sometimes and never go before the main verb:
My brother usually gets up at seven. I never have coffee in the evening.
Also remember: after he, she and it, the verb takes -s.

Your exercise: correct the verb in this sentence, and put usually in the right place.
"She go to bed at ten."
